summary: Standard Lithium Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching a September 8, 2026 press release from its partnership Smackover Lithium (with Equinor) announcing positive results of a Preliminary Economic Assessment (PEA) for the Franklin lithium project in East Texas. The PEA reports an unlevered after-tax NPV of US$5.0 billion, IRR of 24%, payback of 3.1 years, and annual production capacity of up to 70,000 tonnes of lithium carbonate. A resource upgrade and potential bromine/potash by-products are noted. This is a routine project-development disclosure with no transaction, acquisition, divestiture, tender, or other special-situation event. No board recommendation, deal terms, or risk-arb angle exists. The filing is a standard current report; category 'None' applies.
